events.verdict: Isaac (ORL) maintains a legal guarding postion and cleanly deflects the basketball away from Markkanen (CHI).
[Observable in enhanced video] Fournier (ORL) slides his pivot foot at the start of the dribble.
Vucevic (ORL) and Markkanen (CHI) make incidental contact with one another during rebounding.
Holiday (CHI) clamps Fournier's (ORL) arm and restricts his FOM.
Holiday (CHI) wraps his arm around Augustin (ORL) and dislodges him, affecting his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Dunn (CHI) makes marginal contact with Augustin (ORL) while going around the pick.
LaVine (CHI) makes marginal contact with Isaac (ORL) while setting the screen off ball.
Carter Jr. (CHI) briefly engages with Vucevic (ORL) in the post.
Vucevic (ORL) sets the pick on Markkanen (CHI) without giving him room to avoid the contact.
Dunn (CHI) drives to the basket and extends his arm into Augustin (ORL), affecting his defensive position.
LaVine (CHI) makes marginal contact with Fournier (ORL) during his drive to the basket.
Carter Jr. (CHI) makes contact to the ball during the rebound, any additional contact to Vucevic (ORL) is deemed incidental.
Dunn (CHI) makes incidental contact to Simmons' (ORL) body during his passing attempt.
Holiday (CHI) commits a take foul on Augustin (ORL).
Fournier (ORL) makes incidental contact with LaVine (CHI) that does not affect his SQBR.
LaVine (CHI) steps out of bounds in transition.
Dunn (CHI) commits a take foul on Augustin (ORL).
Isaac (ORL) maintains legal guarding position and cleanly blocks LaVine's (CHI) shot attempt.
